description:
ABOUT MIDDESK:

Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.

Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Middesk is expanding its presence in the banking, lending, fintech, and payments sectors, and we're looking for an Account Executive to drive new business growth in these key markets. This role is focused on hunting new logos-identifying, engaging, and closing net-new customers who can benefit from Middesk’s solutions. You’ll own the full sales cycle, building relationships with senior stakeholders in product, compliance, and risk, while developing acquisition strategies to penetrate new accounts. Additionally, you'll provide valuable market feedback to influence Middesk’s product roadmap, ensuring we continue to meet the evolving needs of our customers.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 3 days per week in our NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

- New Business Focus: Drive pipeline growth and close new business within a set list of target accounts while actively hunting for new opportunities.

- Strategic Engagement: Develop tailored engagement plans for senior leaders within key accounts, fostering strong relationships and identifying new partnership opportunities.

- Thought Leadership: Position yourself as an expert on business identity, compliance, and risk, providing valuable insights to support customers’ strategic goals.

- Product Knowledge: Gain deep knowledge of Middesk’s offerings to communicate their value effectively across a variety of use cases and business needs.

- Sales Process Management: Lead the end-to-end sales cycle-from initial outreach to solution evaluation in collaboration with Solutions Engineering, ensuring a smooth handoff to Account Management for long-term growth.

- Customer Advocacy: Act as a trusted advisor to customers, advocating for their needs within Middesk and supporting Account Management in driving account expansion.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

- B2B Sales Experience: 3+ years in a quota-carrying and closing Account Executive role, with a proven track record of exceeding revenue targets in complex sales environments.

- Complex SaaS Sales: Experience selling complex SaaS solutions across multiple stakeholders and decision-makers within an organization.

- Startup Experience: Previous experience in a high-growth, fast-paced startup environment. We are Series B 150 employees

- Strategic Sales Approach: Ability to create tailored solutions for complex buyer journeys and adapt strategies to varied customer needs.

- Relationship Building: Proven experience developing relationships with executive-level stakeholders and influencing buying decisions in cross-functional organizations.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: Demonstrated ownership and initiative in navigating a fast-paced, evolving environment; adaptable and impact-oriented.

- NYC-Based Hybrid Work: Located in the NYC area, with availability for in-office Tuesday

title: Senior Manager, Partner Sales
description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

Your opportunity
New Relic is seeking a hands-on  Senior Manger, Partner Sales to lead the AMER business. This is not a "management-from-afar" role. We need a hands-on, battle-tested leader who will be in the trenches with their team and our Account Executives (AEs) - coaching them on how to nurture, mature, and close new business through the power of the channel. You will lead the charge in a maturing environment, turning ambiguity into execution and evidencing progress over perfection.

What you'll do

Your mission is to accelerate New Relic’s partner sales business with channel partners including VAR, GSI and regional specialists. You will build a team of hunters to overlay the AMER sales team to drive Partner Sourced ACR and launch revitalized sales motions such as MSP and leverage regional services partners to ramp consumption.
Key Responsibilities

• The ACR Engine: Primary accountability for driving Partner Sourced ACR across North America and LATAM. You will ensure the channel is a consistent and predictable contributor to AMER’s growth.

• Deal Orchestration: Act as the "Deal Maker." You will personally support your team and the direct sales organization to mature partner-led opportunities from discovery to close.

• In-the-Trenches Mentorship: We don't want a reporter; we want a coach. You will spend your time upskilling your team on deal mechanics, partner positioning, and cross-functional alignment.

• Sales Alignment: Build a "one-team" culture between the Channel organization and the Direct Sales AEs, ensuring that partner engagement is viewed as a competitive advantage, not a hurdle or cost center.

• Ecosystem Mastery: Leverage your existing network in the Observability to elevate partner relationships and drive executive commitment.

• Operational Resilience: You will operate in an environment that is still evolving. You must be comfortable building the car whilst driving it at the same time

Measures of Success (KPIs)

• Partner Sourced ACR: Achievement of regional gross ACR targets sourced directly by partners

• Pipeline Quality: Measurable improvement in the "Stage 2 to Closed-Won" conversion rate for partner-led deals

• Team Quota Attainment: The percentage of your direct reports hitting or exceeding their sourced-revenue targets

• Direct Sales Alignment: Increasing the "Partner Attachment Rate" across all AMER sales territories

 
This role requires  

• AMER Network: You bring a wealth of executive relationships across the top North American and LATAM VARs, SIs, and regional partners

• The "Deal Maker" DNA: Proven track record of personally helping sales teams close deals through the channel.

• Resilience & Agility: You thrive in environments that are "under construction." You are a builder who can navigate internal ambiguity to deliver external results.

Nice to Have

• Bilingual Advantage:  Proficiency in Spanish or Portuguese is a significant plus for the LATAM component of the role.

• Observability Veteran: Mandatory. You have deep experience in the Observability, APM, or Log Management space. You understand the technical and business value drivers in this specific market.

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Social Media Marketing Assistant
description:
About HighKey

HighKey Agency is a digital PR and social media powerhouse specializing in building elite personal and brand presences in the aesthetic industry-from top-tier plastic surgeons to high-growth med spas.

We engineer content systems that drive visibility, leads, and long-term brand equity-at scale.

Our team moves fast, executes ruthlessly, and obsesses over results. If you’re looking to break into a high-performance agency, this is your entry point-but only if you’re ready to deliver more than what’s expected .

Role Overview

As a Social Media Marketing Assistant , you’ll work directly with our Social Media Managers to help execute world-class content, support account management, and contribute to client-facing success.

This is not a basic scheduling role . You’ll contribute ideas, organize deliverables, coordinate content, and help manage performance for high-profile aesthetic brands. You’ll be expected to take ownership over your tasks, solve problems, and level up fast.

If you’re hungry to build your career in digital marketing-and you thrive in high-speed environments-this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

1. Content Coordination + Prep

• Help build and organize viral content scripts for Instagram, TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

• Assist with content prep for client filming sessions (scripts, hooks, trends, shot lists).

• Work alongside video editors and graphic designers to move content through the pipeline.

2. Platform Management + Engagement

• Monitor and respond to comments, DMs, and tags across platforms.

• Track trends and help brainstorm fast-moving ideas for reactive content.

• Assist in managing community tone, voice, and consistency for each client brand.

3. Performance Support + Reporting

• Pull analytics and track KPIs weekly: reach, retention, engagement rate, virality.

• Assist with preparing client-facing performance reports and insights.

• Identify what’s working and flag what’s not-so we can pivot fast.

4. Administrative Execution

• Keep things clean and moving inside Notion, Basecamp, and Hootsuite.

• Help maintain organized content libraries, file systems, and calendars.

• Communicate across internal teams (design, editing, accounts) to keep projects on track.

You’re a Fit If…

• You have 1-2 years of real-world experience in content marketing, social media, or digital strategy (agency or in-house).

• You’ve managed posts, calendars, or performance for real brands-this isn’t your first exposure to client work.

• You know your way around Instagram, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Meta tools .

• You’re extremely organized , detail-obsessed, and good at tracking moving parts.

• You’re not afraid to ask questions, take initiative, and move fast.

• You have experience using tools like Notion, Hootsuite, Canva, Google Docs, Basecamp , etc.

• You’re passionate about branding, storytelling, and content that performs.

Bonus If You Have:

• Experience working with aesthetics, med spa, cosmetic, or personal branding clients.

• Video editing or videography background (CapCut, Canva, Adobe).

• Insight into how to make content go viral .

Growth Path

This is not just a task-based role-it’s a pipeline into Social Media Manager positions at HighKey. As you prove you can think strategically, communicate clearly, and execute fast, you’ll get more ownership, more client-facing exposure, and eventually full account leadership.

Culture + Commitment

•
Full-time, hourly role starting at $15-$20/hr , depending on experience.

• Remote position with flexible hours (but responsiveness matters).

• Promotion potential into salaried client management roles.

• We value speed, clarity, extreme ownership, and team accountability.

How to Apply

Submit your resume + Portfolio

📩 Extra credit : Share a recent TikTok or Reel trend and how you’d adapt it for a plastic surgeon or med spa.

Salary: $15 - $20 / hour Originally posted on Himalayas

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

WHY THIS MATTERS

Runway is building AI to simulate the world. We think world models, not language models alone, are the path to general-purpose simulation: systems that experience the world, learn from their mistakes, and change how stories get told, how science gets done, and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Applied AI is where that research meets a customer with a deadline. Every one of the world's largest studios, brands, and platforms hits a moment where Runway stops being a demo and becomes the way they actually make things. Our team exists for that moment, and we organize around one question: what's blocking this customer from production, and how do we remove it?

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a role for people who want to own a problem, not an account. You'll sit with the biggest studios, brands, and Fortune 100 companies in the world, figure out what's actually standing between them and production, and build whatever removes it. Some weeks that's a workflow. Some weeks it's a plugin or an integration nobody has written yet. Some weeks it's getting a room of executives to make a decision they've been putting off.

Your work will be on screen: Emmy-winning shows, Oscar-winning films, Super Bowl commercials, the stuff people actually watch. And the things you build for one customer tend to become product for all of them. Our team's first Shopify plugin started as a customer blocker and was in engineering's hands within a few weeks. We treat this team as R&D for that reason, not as a cost center.

We have offices in NYC, San Francisco, Seattle, and London.

NO TWO WEEKS ARE THE SAME, BUT YOU CAN EXPECT TO:

- Find the real problem: sit with the creative, technical, and executive teams at a customer, map how they actually work, and locate the blocker between them and production. Usually it's one of three things: a missing integration, an unproven pipeline, or a stakeholder who isn't convinced yet.

- Build the first of its kind: the demo that shows a studio head or a Fortune 100 CMO something nobody has shown them before. Working proofs of concept on the customer's own brand, footage, or catalog, often built in a day or two before the meeting, and the best of them become product for everyone.

- Make it reusable: turn the one-off that unblocked one customer into the workflow, plugin, or integration the next ten customers start from.

- Run the evaluation: own evaluation plans end to end, guide managed trials, build tailored demos on the customer's own footage and brand, and carry the technical side of deal cycles with AEs.

- Scope deployments that land: 4-12 week engagements with customer-defined success criteria, a hands-on builder and an executive sponsor on their side from day one, and enough discipline to keep them on scope when the asks start piling up.

- Get customers to production fast: take new technical and non-technical customers from signed contract to first production call in days rather than quarters, grow API-only accounts into Platform

title: Sr. Solution Architect
description:
About Wherobots

Wherobots is the AI Context Engine for the Physical World: the missing infrastructure layer for AI that needs to reason about our physical reality. Existing AI context infrastructure was built for text, code, documents, databases, and the internet. The most consequential enterprise decisions also depend on the physical world: supply chains, climate exposure, geopolitics, infrastructure, and more.

Our two products let teams use familiar SQL and Python to analyze physical-world data and give AI agents persistent context about their organization’s assets and operations:

•
Wherobots DB is a fully distributed spatial analytics engine with a Rust-native execution layer. It processes vector and raster data in the same engine at scale, enabling precise spatial joins across billions of geometries and analysis that connects imagery with business data.

•
RasterFlow is a fully distributed, serverless engine for raster preparation and computer vision. It processes satellite imagery at planetary scale, runs built-in or custom PyTorch models, and turns imagery into predictions and spatial features that teams can analyze with Wherobots DB.

Wherobots was founded by the original creators of Apache Sedona, the open-source spatial computing platform with more than 80 million downloads. Apache Sedona is used in production by tens of thousands of organizations, including many Fortune 500 companies.

About the role

Wherobots is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to help enterprise customers design and adopt geospatial data solutions. You will partner with sales throughout technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, then help customers move into production and expand their use of Wherobots .

This is a customer-facing role with hands-on technical work . You will help customers connect raster ETL, spatial analytics, and computer vision or machine learning use cases to their business needs. You will also create reusable technical resources and bring customer feedback to product and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

•
Pre-sales: Lead technical discovery. Partner with sales and marketing to understand customer business challenges, data infrastructure, and analytics needs. Translate those requirements into proposed solutions and clear success criteria.

•
Pre-sales: Design solution architectures. Develop architecture diagrams, integration flows, and deployment plans tailored to customer environments, including platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, and Google Earth Engine.

•
Pre-sales: Deliver demonstrations and proofs of concept. Build customer-specific demonstrations, notebooks, and benchmarks that show how Wherobots supports raster ETL, spatial analytics, and ML workflows. Help customers evaluate technical fit and business value.

•
Post-sales: Lead architectural onboarding. Guide new customers from evaluation into production, working with their engineering and analytics teams to establish implementation plans and operational best practices.

•
Post-sales: Support customer implementations. Help customers design data ingestion and transformation pipelines, spatial analysis workflows, and model inference integrations, including storage, querying, visualization, and governance.

•
Post-sales: Troubleshoot technical issues. Serve as a technical escalation point and work with product and support engineering to resolve issues and improve customer deployments.

•
Create reusable technical resources. Develop reference architectures, implementation guides, Jupyter notebooks, tutorials, and technical blog posts. Share practical examples through workshops, webinars, technical events, and community engagement.

•
Inform product direction. Collect customer requirements and implementation feedback to help prioritize improvements to Wherobots capabilities, APIs, and documentation.

Qualifications

• 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role covering pre-sales and post-sales

When a leak is reported in a building, someone has to work out what is actually going on. Which areas are affected. Whether it needs a plumber, a roofer or a waterproofing specialist. Whether one quote is enough or three are needed. And what to tell the owners while it is being sorted out. That is this role.
You will manage the day-to-day maintenance of a portfolio of Australian commercial and strata properties, working fully remote from the Philippines on Australian business hours. Every job is yours from the moment it is reported through investigation, quoting, approval, coordination and completion - plumbing, electrical, roofing, waterproofing, leaks, painting, carpentry, glazing, doors, access systems and general building repairs.
It is a high-volume role across multiple sites, and it suits someone with hands-on technical knowledge who can look at a request and know what it needs - working through the requests themselves, not managing a team who does.
You will be choosing which contractor to engage, comparing their quotes and putting a clear recommendation in front of property and strata managers. It is decision-making work rather than passing messages between contractors and clients, and it builds the kind of Australian property and building knowledge that stays with you.
What you’ll be doing

• Reviewing incoming maintenance requests across a portfolio of properties and deciding the appropriate next step

title: Senior AI Product & Partnerships Counsel
description:
We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems - robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco, but open to hiring around the US for the right candidate.

Join the frontier of shaping generative AI video and its legal landscape as an early lawyer at Runway wearing multiple hats. As AI Product & Partnerships Counsel, your mission is to enable the company to ship better products faster and accelerate product and data partnerships and other go-to-market deals. You are a self-starter who thrives at getting things done in fast-paced, unstructured environments. You have a passion for building scalable initiatives across our product and commercial legal workstreams.

You will serve as a strategic partner to product, engineering, partnerships, sales, marketing, and the Runway Executive Team. Comfort working within a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Become a go-to advisor for product legal matters, from design to launch, by providing pragmatic, product-motivated advice

- Accelerate AI product development and integrations by building playbooks and streamlining legal review of partnership deals, including data partnerships, IP and model licensing, procurement, reseller, and marketplace agreements

- Accelerate AI product adoption by closing deals with Runway’s strategic partners and customers. These include B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI SaaS platform and APIs, DPAs, and order forms.

- Dive into the technical aspects of our generative AI products to learn them inside and out, to inform your advice to the business

- Closely follow (and even shape) technical, legal, and policy developments in AI and translate them into practical product guidance

- Implement practices allowing our legal team to scale our impact on the business, including enablement, self-serve resources, and AI-enabled automation

WHAT YOU’LL NEED

- 6+ years of relevant experience, including in-house experience at a fast-paced technology company

- Experience advising product development leaders and executives across a broad range of issues, especially IP and privacy

- Experience closing partnership and go-to-market deals, such as data partnerships; IP and model licensing; robotics, hardware, and compute agreements; reseller; and other partner, customer, and vendor deals

- Experience providing practical recommendations to senior leaders with limited time and information

- Sound judgment in ambiguity: track record of gathering key information quickly and helping the business make smart decisions

- Deep sense of ownership, whether you're advising our CEO on a novel legal issue or testing your new AI-enabled workflow for the nth time

- Bias for action: why put something off if you can do it now?

title: Training Supervisor
description:
At HelloFresh, every person who walks through our doors on day one deserves a strong and well structured start. As Training Supervisor, you will be the first face new starters see, the person who makes sure everyone is safe, skilled, and confident during their HelloFresh journey.

The Training Supervisor role is fast-paced, visible, and varied. No two weeks look the same when you're supporting a high-growth food production site. 

You'll lead and performance manage our Training Ambassadors, acting as their coach and point of escalation. Reporting into the Learning Business Partner, you'll play a key role in shaping how training is delivered across the site.

What You Will Be Doing:

• Host the training team shift handover brief at the start and end of each shift.

• Own the new starter experience end-to-end: delivering classroom inductions, site tours, and hands-on safety training so every joiner feels welcomed and work-ready from day one.

• Deliver ongoing Health & Safety and Food Safety refresher training in line with business policy and current legislation.

• Oversee the physical sign off process for safe systems of work and standard operating procedures, maintaining accurate training records in the training matrix.

• Run classroom and on-the-job sessions for a range of skills across Production and Warehouse.

• Use training data and compliance reporting to plan shift cover, identify gaps, and provide KPI updates to Training Management.

• Lead, coach, and performance manage the Training Ambassador team, including regular 1:1s, development conversations, and holding high standards.

• A single point of reference for the operational management team for essential business needs.
Champion Health & Safety in everything you do: lead by example, challenge unsafe behaviours, and motivate others to do the same.

• Ensure tech is fully accounted for and in excellent condition.

• Support training improvement projects and contribute to the continuous development of how we train at HelloFresh.

Who You Are:

• You have at least 1 year of experience in a training role, ideally within an operational, warehouse, or food production environment.

• You're a natural communicator, delivering a safety induction to 40+ new starters or having a one-to-one performance conversation with a Training Ambassador.

• You take Health & Safety seriously. You don't walk past it. You call it out, correct it, and help others understand why it matters.

• You're organised and data-driven. You can read a training matrix, spot a compliance gap, and take action without being asked.

• You have experience managing or supervising others, and you know how to get the best out of a team.

• You're adaptable and embrace change. When processes change or priorities shift, you recalibrate quickly and bring your team with you.

• English fluency is essential; additional languages are a real asset given the diversity of our site teams.

title: #61 - Arquitecto Sase
description:
Overall del rol
Buscamos un/a Arquitecto/a SASE/SSE con fuerte orientación a cliente para incorporarse a consultora especialista en infraestructura, networking, cloud y ciberseguridad (partner de Cisco y Microsoft, reconocida como Cybersecurity Partner of the Year 2023 y Partner of the Year 2024).
La persona liderará el diseño y despliegue de soluciones de infraestructura, redes y seguridad en un entorno corporativo de alta exigencia.
Será responsable de definir arquitecturas end-to-end combinando tecnologías Cisco, Microsoft y otros fabricantes, presentarlas directamente al cliente y coordinar su ejecución junto a los partners tecnológicos involucrados.
No es un rol de gestión pura ni de ejecución técnica aislada: se busca un perfil capaz de conectar visión técnica, cliente y delivery real.
Skills

•
SASE (Secure Access Service Edge): modelo que junta la red y la seguridad en un mismo servicio en la nube, para que cualquier usuario se conecte de forma segura desde donde esté, sin pasar por una oficina física.

•
SSE (Security Service Edge): la parte de seguridad del modelo SASE (sin la parte de red pura): filtrado web, protección de acceso a aplicaciones y control de datos, todo desde la nube.

•
Arquitectura de seguridad perimetral: diseño de las "murallas" que protegen la red de una empresa frente a accesos externos no autorizados (firewalls, control de tráfico entrante/saliente).

•
Acceso seguro: soluciones para que empleados, proveedores o dispositivos entren a los sistemas de la empresa de forma controlada y verificada (VPN, autenticación multifactor, acceso remoto seguro).

•
Redes y seguridad en entornos Cisco: manejo de los equipos y software de red más usados en empresas grandes (switches, routers, firewalls Cisco).

•
Microsoft Azure: la nube de Microsoft, donde las empresas alojan servidores, aplicaciones y datos.

•
Windows Server: sistema operativo con el que se gestionan los servidores internos de una empresa (usuarios, archivos, aplicaciones).

•
AD/Entra ID: el directorio donde se guardan los usuarios de una empresa y sus permisos de acceso; Entra ID es la versión en la nube de Active Directory.

•
Intune: herramienta de Microsoft para gestionar y proteger de forma remota los dispositivos (portátiles, móviles) de los empleados.

Must-haves

• Al menos 5 años de experiencia en arquitectura de seguridad perimetral y acceso seguro.

•
Experiencia sólida en diseño y despliegue de soluciones en cliente final. El rol implica presentar y ejecutar soluciones con un cliente real de alta exigencia, no trabajo aislado de laboratorio.

• Conocimientos en redes y/o seguridad, especialmente en entornos Cisco.

•
Background técnico en entornos Microsoft (Azure, Windows Server, AD/Entra ID, Intune). Las arquitecturas combinan Cisco y Microsoft; sin este conocimiento solo se cubriría la mitad de la solución.

•

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves:

• Professional experience working with Golang

You can read API documentation independently and have a precise conversation with engineers about what an integration should do. Zendesk Apps Framework experience is a plus but not required.

title: Senior Manager, Market Access Specialty Care
description:
Support the Director of Market Access to develop and execute market access strategies that enable optimal launch, pricing, reimbursement, and sustainable access to a specialty care indications across international markets and designated partner regions. The role requires strategic thinking, cross-functional collaboration, and solid knowledge of international market access policies, health economics, and stakeholder engagement to deliver timely and equitable patient access.
Main responsibilities

• Planning: Support development and implementation of comprehensive market access strategies tailored to launching Specialty care product, diverse international markets and partner regions, aligned with corporate objectives, regulatory landscapes, and local affiliate needs.

• Pricing and reimbursement: Collaborate to secure pricing, reimbursement, and formulary inclusion for new and existing products, leveraging health economic models, budget impact analyses, and value-based arguments.

• Evidence and value communication: Support the development of HEOR evidence, real-world data (RWD), and global/local value dossiers to inform HTA submissions and payer negotiations; contribute to objection handlers and payer negotiation materials.

• Stakeholder engagement: Build and maintain compliant relationships with external stakeholders (payers, HTA agencies, partners, regulatory bodies, and patient advocacy groups) to facilitate access, inform strategy, and shape evidence needs.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with global and local Medical, Commercial, Regulatory, Legal, and Government Affairs teams to synchronize market access initiatives, share best practices, and ensure launch readiness.

• Policy monitoring and advocacy: Monitor policy developments and trends across international and partner regions; proactively identify risks and opportunities and support advocacy efforts that enhance patient access.

• Project leadership and operations: Manage multiple concurrent market access projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget adherence, risk management, and measurable outcomes; oversee vendor activities where relevant.

• Reporting and metrics: Track, analyse, and report on access performance, milestones (e.g., HTA outcomes, P&R decisions), and competitive intelligence across assigned regions; maintain accurate, timely updates in PRISMA, Smartsheet, and other internal systems.

• Education: Advanced degree in life sciences, pharmacy, public health, economics, or related field (PhD, MSc, MBA preferred).

• 7+ years in market access and reimbursement within international region role, focusing on GI, internal medicine, endocrinology, Cardiovascular and rare disease market access, with strong understanding for both niche and large patient populations reimbursement.

• Proven track record in international launch planning and execution, including access strategy development with payers and policy makers networks for both niche and large populations markets.

• Effective track record working in matrixed, multicultural teams across different regions.

• Good understanding of international healthcare systems, HTA processes, and both public and private payers’ environment.

title: Co-Op, IT/OT Security Analyst
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila runs autonomous science facilities - labs full of instruments, robotics, and controllers that produce the experimental data that is the company's core IP. Securing that environment is a different problem from securing laptops and SaaS, and we are building the program from the ground up. This co-op works on that build, not on the side of it.

The role sits at the seam between IT, Lab IT, and OT, spanning four workstreams: OT asset visibility and tooling, vulnerability and patch management across IT/OT, SOC integration and threat intelligence, and program build. The work product outlives the term.

What we are looking for is someone curious enough to trace a problem end to end without being handed the answer, and persistent enough to stay with it when the architecture is not documented anywhere. We will teach the OT domain. We cannot teach that.

What You'll Be Building

• Own day-to-day OT asset discovery and reconciliation, closing the gap between device detection and documented ownership

• Prioritize vulnerabilities across IT/OT environments by real consequence (safety, experiment integrity, IP exposure, throughput) rather than raw CVSS scores

• Coordinate remediation with automation engineering within established maintenance windows

• Integrate OT and network telemetry into the SIEM, triage alerts, and supply OT context the SOC team lacks

• Track threat intelligence relevant to lab automation and biotech; convert findings into detections and written briefings

• Build program artifacts (asset intake process, connectivity risk reviews, segmentation documentation) that remain operational after the term ends

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, network engineering, or a related field

• Working knowledge of TCP/IP networking: VLANs, subnetting, routing and switching basics, firewall concepts (the single most important prerequisite - OT security is a networking job before it is a security job)

• Comfort on the command line (Windows and Linux) and basic scripting in Python or PowerShell for data reconciliation and reporting

• Strong written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical changes to non-technical audiences and security constraints to operational teams

• Availability to work onsite at Alewife on a hybrid schedule, including hands-on work with physical hardware

Bonus Points For

• Exposure to vulnerability management concepts: CVE/CVSS, scanning, remediation workflow

• Familiarity with SIEM or log analysis on any platform (Splunk, Sentinel, Elastic, Chronicle); coursework, CTF, or homelab experience counts

• Cloud fundamentals, AWS preferred

• Any exposure to ICS/OT, SCADA, lab instrumentation, or robotics environments
About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

title: Researcher, World Models
description:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.
The Role
We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.
What You'll Do

• Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

• Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

• Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

• Own the data pipeline for your experiments end to end: curation, tooling, and scaling, without depending on a separate data-engineering team to move.

• Integrate what you build with our platform, firmware, and software teams so research reaches the robot, not just the paper.

• Contribute to sim-to-real transfer, inverse dynamics, and multi-modal sensor fusion, and publish or open-source work where it strengthens the field and the team.

What We Look For

• Proven modeling track record: you have trained models and can show solid, honest evaluations, not just training curves.

• JEPA fluency: you understand the joint-embedding predictive approach and can reason about where it fits versus alternatives.

• Breadth across approaches: familiarity with prior and adjacent work, including VLA (vision-language-action) models, and a view on their trade-offs.

• Depth in a modality: strong depth in at least one sensory domain (vision, audio, natural language, or similar).

• Strong data abilities: you get things done without depending on a whole data-engineering team.

• Solid engineering: you can implement, integrate, and ship what you build alongside platform, firmware, and software teams.

• Conversant, ideally deep, in several of: SSL for visual and sensor representations; world models (JEPA, V-JEPA, I-JEPA, LeJEPA, MJEPA); generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs); robotics ML (VLA, inverse dynamics, sim-to-real, optical flow); sensor fusion (vision, proprioception, force/torque, multi-modal encoders); PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training.

Nice to Have

• Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, or RSS (or arXiv work with comparable citations).

• PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, robotics, or computer vision. Not required with a strong portfolio.

• Demonstrated hardware or robotics interest or hands-on experience.

• Strong communication: technical blogs, talks, or clear written research.

Why Join Menlo

World models are the bet that lets a humanoid generalize instead of memorize. This is a rare seat where your research runs on real hardware in short cycles, your data and modeling choices are yours to own, and your work ships in the open. If you want the distance between an idea and a walking robot to be measured in weeks, this is the room.

A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
The Connectivity team builds products that connect our most critical institutions to their most critical data. Our connectors integrate databases, enterprise applications, cloud storage, web services, and streaming systems, enabling customers to bring data into Foundry and write back to their operational systems. From large datasets to real-time events and user-driven interactions, these connections underpin the applications and AI workflows customers build with Foundry and AIP.
 
You’ll help build Foundry’s first-class connector suite and the shared infrastructure behind it. You’ll work across the stack, taking ownership of connector implementations, developer SDKs, and the systems that build, test, distribute, and run our connectivity software.

You will see your work through design, code review, testing, and release.

Debug production issues and performance problems across the stack, turning recurring support problems into durable fixes, automated tests, and better observability.

Technologies We Use
Java and Python for connectors, backend services, and developer SDKs
Open-source technologies like Kafka, Kubernetes, Flink, Debezium, Iceberg

Shared job orchestration, streaming, serverless execution, and compute deployment platforms

title: Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineer (virtual, US)
description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections - with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya , you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

Job Description

Eligibility Requirement: US Citizenship Required

Reduce Risk. Accelerate Remediation. Strengthen Infrastructure Security.

Are you passionate about cybersecurity, vulnerability management, and reducing technology risk across complex cloud environments? Do you enjoy analyzing security vulnerabilities, partnering with technical teams, and driving remediation efforts that strengthen the security and resilience of critical systems?

We’re looking for two Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineers to help identify, prioritize, track, and remediate vulnerabilities across infrastructure and applications within a cloud-based FedRAMP Moderate-compliant environment supporting US federal government requirements.

This role will focus on accelerating vulnerability remediation in alignment with applicable Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) Binding Operational Directive (BOD) 26-04 requirements, leveraging threat intelligence, exposure data, and cloud-based AI tools to help application and infrastructure teams address security risks efficiently and effectively.

The ideal candidates bring hands-on vulnerability management experience, strong technical troubleshooting skills, and the ability to collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, vendors, and risk partners to drive vulnerabilities through resolution.

The Opportunity

As an Infrastructure Security Vulnerability Engineer, you’ll play a critical role in reducing the organization’s technology risk by managing vulnerability remediation activities from identification through closure. You’ll analyze findings from vulnerability assessment tools, evaluate risk and exposure, coordinate remediation plans, and track progress through established systems of record.

You’ll work closely with application managers, infrastructure teams, vendor managers, and risk partners to ensure vulnerabilities are prioritized appropriately and remediated within required time frames. You’ll also use cloud-based AI tools and established security practices to support vulnerability identification, improve remediation workflows, and contribute to reporting and continuous process improvement.

This role is ideal for a security professional who combines technical vulnerability analysis with strong coordination, communication, and reporting skills in a regulated cloud environment.

Your Mission-Critical Responsibilities

Vulnerability Management & Remediation: Lead and coordinate vulnerability remediation activities across infrastructure and applications, ensuring identified vulnerabilities are tracked, prioritized, and resolved in accordance with established security requirements and remediation timelines.

Exposure-Based Risk Prioritization: Evaluate vulnerabilities using CVE and CVSS data, exploitability, threat intelligence, asset criticality, attack paths, exposure information, and other relevant risk indicators to help determine remediation priorities.

CISA Directive Alignment: Support vulnerability remediation activities aligned with applicable CISA BOD 26-04 requirements and other relevant federal cybersecurity directives, including monitoring remediation progress against required deadlines.

Infrastructure & Application Security: Support vulnerability assessment and remediation across Windows Server 2019 and above, Linux/RHEL 9.x and above, and application environments.

ABOUT CLIPBOARD

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.

Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company https://www.ycombinator.com/topcompanies/ and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Sales Commission Analyst role sits at the intersection of finance, sales operations, and analytics. Owning the accuracy, integrity, and clarity of how Clipboard pays its revenue-generating teams.

You're likely someone with sharp spreadsheet instincts and a low tolerance for unexplained numbers. You're comfortable enough in SQL to pull your own data, fluent in comp plan mechanics, and just as capable of explaining a payout discrepancy in plain English to a rep as you are tracing the formula that caused it. You take ownership of the details because you know one uninvestigated row error erodes trust in the whole system.

You will:

- Calculate and process commission payouts accurately and on time each pay cycle, catching and resolving discrepancies before they land in a paycheck.

- Own the mechanics of our commission plans, the calculations, tiers, and accelerators. Keeping the spreadsheets and systems that run them aligned to plan documentation.

- Query and reconcile data across systems to validate commissionable revenue and investigate payout questions.

- Partner with Sales, Finance, and RevOps to roll out new or updated comp plans, translating plan changes into working, auditable calculations.

- Field and resolve rep-facing commission questions with clear, reliable written communication.

- Build and maintain tools and dashboards that make commission tracking transparent and self-service for reps and managers.

What you bring:

- Spreadsheet mastery. You build and audit complex, multi-tab models without breaking them.

- Working SQL skills, comfortable pulling and reconciling data across sources.

- Comp plan literacy. You can read a plan document and translate it into an accurate calculation.

- Sharp attention to detail; you catch the error before it becomes a payout problem.

- Strong, reliable written communication for explaining numbers to non-analysts.

- Project ownership. You can take a commission cycle or plan rollout from start to finish with minimal oversight.

Experience

- 0-2 years in FP&A, sales operations, commissions/compensation, analytics, or a comparable analytical role.

What We Offer

- Competitive base salary

- Insurance benefits and 401k options

- Unlimited PTO and flexible holidays

- Remote-first flexibility
